severity_criteria.source_excerpt: Eligibility criteria: "Subject must have an Evaluator's Global Severity Score (EGSS) of 3 (moderate) or 4 (severe) at the baseline visit... facial acne inflammatory lesion... count no less than 30, but no more than 100... non-inflammatory lesion... count no less than 35, but no more than 150... Subjects with 2 or fewer facial nodules." A different named scale (EGSS, 0-4: Clear/Almost Clear/Mild/Moderate/Severe) than the acne-specific IGA scale (0-5) already used for Amzeeq -- both are real, distinct instruments used by different sponsors for the same disease.

prohibited_concomitant: topical or systemic medications requiring concurrent use in/on the treatment area (subjects without an appropriate washout were excluded)
value.population_note: A 12-week randomized, double-blind, vehicle-controlled 2:1 trial of a fixed triple-combination topical gel in subjects 9 years and older with moderate-to-severe facial acne vulgaris.

background_therapy.source_excerpt: protocolSection.eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria exclusion criteria: "Subjects who have not undergone specified washout period(s) for topical preparations/physical treatments used on the face or subjects who require the concurrent use in the treatment area" and "...for systemic medications or subjects who require the concurrent use of systemic medications." This is a real, quoted washout/no-concurrent-use requirement, though weaker evidence than Amzeeq's explicit 'no other medication was permitted for use during these studies' label sentence -- no equivalent label statement exists for Cabtreo, so this field is built from CT.gov eligibility text alone.
